More [[corsair]]s have been seen near [[Kodlonu Hamlet]] - go with [[Rahlon]] and eradicate them!

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
 |campaign = Nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Go with Rahlon and protect the village from corsairs.
* Eradicate the corsairs in [[Mehtani Keys]].
* Speak with [[Elder Olunideh]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]
* 15 [[Sunspear promotion point]]s
* [[Battle Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
{{section-stub}}
Meet Rahlon right outside the gate of Kodlonu Hamlet and head south to the corsair camp shown on the map. Rahlon does not need to survive to complete the quest. There are about 10 corsairs at the camp and one corsair boss. Kill them all and go back to Kodlonu Hamlet to get your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Elder Olunideh
:''"More '''corsairs''' have been sighted! We must do something about them before they get any ideas about plundering our villages. We could very much use a hero like you, if you would join us."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Corsairs? I'm not afraid of corsairs!
|decline = I'm sure you can handle it without me.
|ask = The corsairs have started raiding. '''Rahlon''' needs you immediately. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Rahlon
:''"You've come to help us? Well, the more the merrier. My friends and I are tired of these filthy corsairs constantly harassing us. We've decided that we aren't going to sit back and let them push us around anymore. They've set up a camp south of here. We're going there to finish this one way or another. Let's go teach those stinking seamen whose island this is!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Elder Olunideh
:''"Thank you for helping us, <player name>. I will send a letter to your superiors telling them of your bravery and generosity.''

==Notes==
*The [[Sunspear Scout]] at the resurrection shrine just north of the camp offers a [[Corsair Bounty]] for a few extra [[Sunspear rank]] points.
*Don't forget to open the [[Treasure Chest]] while you're there, if you haven't already done so recently.
